name: codehub
description: Interact with Huawei CodeHub (codehub-y.huawei.com / codehub-g.huawei.com) Git repositories via the local `Codehub-Mcp-Server` MCP server. Exposes project lookup, merge-request lifecycle (list/detail/changes/reviews/create/merge), issues (list/detail/discussions/create/update), and repo file reading. Unlike remote MCP tools in this repo, this is a LOCAL stdio server launched via `uvx`, so it requires `uv`/`uvx` installed, intranet artifactory reachability (first run fetches the Python tarball), and a CodeHub PRIVATE_TOKEN. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).
command_note: Three fixes beyond the upstream config, all forced by the corporate TLS-intercepting proxy and the server's packaging gaps (diagnosed via the repo's git-corporate-proxy-lfs skill): (1) --allow-insecure-host cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com — the proxy re-signs the artifactory's TLS cert, so uv rejects it as a connect error unless TLS verification is relaxed for this host. (2) --with python-dotenv — the server imports dotenv but omits it from pyproject.toml dependencies. (3) --with 'mcp<2' — the server imports FastMCP from mcp.server, which mcp 2.0 removed; pin to 1.x to match the server's expected API.

runtime.install: first invocation runs `uvx` which downloads the server tarball from the Huawei intranet artifactory; subsequent runs use the uv cache. `uvx` is NOT bundled — install `uv` separately (https://github.com/astral-sh/uv).
runtime.note: This tool is NOT install-free. Unlike the remote w3-search tool (pure-stdlib wrapper hitting a URL), this is a local Python server that must be fetched and launched by uvx. A fresh git clone of this repo cannot run it without: (1) uv/uvx on PATH, (2) intranet/VPN reachability to cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com + mirrors.tools.huawei.com, (3) a PRIVATE_TOKEN. The corporate proxy does TLS interception, so --allow-insecure-host must cover the artifactory host (see command_note); uv ignores NO_PROXY for this on Windows.

environment.X_AUTH_TOKEN: <optional: alternative auth token, used if PRIVATE_TOKEN unset>
environment.REPO_AGENT_HOST: <optional: needed only for the review-via-repoagent tool variant>

network.note: uvx must reach the intranet artifactory (cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com) and the PyPI mirror (mirrors.tools.huawei.com). The corporate proxy (proxyuk.huawei.com:8080) does TLS interception: it re-signs the artifactory's cert, so uv rejects the connection with 'client error (Connect)' UNLESS --allow-insecure-host cmc.centralrepo.rnd.huawei.com is passed (already in the command above). This is the same class of problem the repo's git-corporate-proxy-lfs skill documents for git (http.schannelCheckRevoke=false). Setting NO_PROXY alone does NOT fix uv on Windows — uv reads the registry proxy and ignores the bypass list for TLS verification.

auth_detail: CodeHub PRIVATE_TOKEN (personal access token) or X_AUTH_TOKEN. Set in environment. The server exits at startup if neither is present.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: 基于本地Git仓库URL获取远程代码仓项目的详细信息，返回整数项目ID（其他工具的入参）。

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: 列举远程仓库上的合并请求（MR）任务列表。

args.name: project_id
args.help: 代码仓的唯一数字ID（由 get_project_info 获得）

tools.name: get_merge_request_info
tools.description: 获取单个合并请求的详细信息（标题、描述，不含变更代码）。

tools.name: get_merge_request_changes
tools.description: 获取合并请求的实际变更内容（变更文件和diff）。filters=commits 可返回MR内的提交列表。

tools.name: get_merge_request_mergeable_state
tools.description: 获取单个合并请求的门禁状态（冲突/CI/审批/E2E等检查）。

tools.name: get_merge_request_reviews
tools.description: 获取指定合并任务的所有检视意见（review comments）。对自演进而言，反复出现的检视意见=反复犯的错误，是强信号。

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: 基于源分支和目标分支创建合并请求（MR）。写操作。

args.name: issue_nums
args.help: 关联工单号，多个用;分割

tools.name: merge_merge_request
tools.description: 将合并请求的源分支合入目标分支。写操作。

args.name: merge_commit_message
args.help: 附加到自动提交消息的额外信息

tools.name: create_merge_request_review
tools.description: 在远程仓库上创建review意见（指定文件、行号）。写操作。

tools.name: resolve_merge_request_reviews
tools.description: 标记指定review意见为已解决/未解决。写操作。

tools.name: get_repo_file
tools.description: 获取远程仓库指定分支的指定文件内容。

tools.name: get_project_issues
tools.description: 获取项目的Issue列表，支持按状态/作者/分配人/标签等过滤。可用 author_id 查某人的工单。

tools.name: create_issue_discussion
tools.description: 向指定Issue添加评论。写操作。

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: 在指定项目中创建新Issue。写操作。

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: 更新已存在的Issue（标题/描述/分配人/状态等）。写操作。
